objective: Distinguish locally sensed cells from radio-only cells in the PPO spatial observation.

architecture.new_channel: cumulative known cells received by radio but never locally sensed

protocol.rejection_rule: Do not open the reserved test when validation does not beat the V5 reference.

decision: Reject V6 for deployment. Keep V5 base seed97 with optional normal map sharing.
lesson: Explicit provenance helps warm-started V6 relative to training from scratch, but a raw binary provenance channel is not sufficient to improve the deployed policy.
